faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up and running elab QR Menu
faq_q1: How long does it take to get our digital menu live?
faq_a1: Just 5 to 10 minutes. Sign up, snap a photo of your paper menu with our AI importer, and your digital storefront and QR codes are ready.
faq_q2: Do we need to buy expensive POS terminals or hardware?
faq_a2: None at all. elab works seamlessly on any existing smartphones, tablets, or computers you already own.
faq_q3: Do guests have to download an app from App Store or Google Play?
faq_a3: Never. It opens instantly in mobile Safari or Chrome when scanning the QR code, with zero app installation.
faq_q4: Can we try the system for free?
faq_a4: Yes, every new registration includes a 14-day full-featured free trial with no credit card required.
faq_q5: How do we get printed QR stands for our tables?
faq_a5: Our built-in QR Studio lets you design branded QR cards with table numbers and download print-ready high-resolution files instantly.
